slug: 2026-03-12 Africa’s Data Protection Reforms A Continental Perspective on the Drivers of Change in Legal Frameworks

facts.fact: FPF states Seychelles repealed its never-implemented 2002 Data Protection Act with the Data Protection Act 2023, which it describes as a move to a regime grounded in enforcement; it gives no commencement date (as_of is the gazetted date of the 2023 Act, per the linked text).

FPF states the 2023 Act empowers the Information Commission to conduct audits and inspections, issue enforcement notices and impose administrative fines; it does not say any such power has been used (as_of is the Act's date).
